items.title: Five Nights at Freddy's Pop-Up Store
items.summary: The Five Nights at Freddy's Pop-Up Store was the first official Five Nights at Freddy's pop-up store in Japan, produced by InfoLens Inc.  The pop-up store closed on March 10, 2024.
